cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The first candidate-bound acceptance attempt called is_file on os.stat_result while checking the trusted Node executable, so the runner crashed before the frontend product-path command and before writing a manifest.
impact: The acceptance result was not produced; no product pass was inferred. The check was corrected to use an explicit regular-file mode test and the same candidate was rerun.
lesson: Acceptance infrastructure needs its own executable preflight tests and must turn infrastructure failures into typed blocked results rather than uncaught tracebacks.

cause: The first successful deterministic runner invocation derived the catalog and coverage matrix from the evaluator checkout before executing the candidate tests; the evaluator had eight providers and twenty rows while the exact candidate had seven providers and fifteen rows.
impact: That first manifest was invalidated and must not be used as candidate evidence. The runner now performs catalog, coverage, and matrix discovery inside the candidate interpreter/PYTHONPATH before writing a sidecar.
lesson: Candidate-bound evidence must bind not only test commands and SHA but also every denominator and digest source to the candidate being evaluated.

cause: Appending the runner failure to the historical v1-8-9-foundation-integration line was rejected by the formal CLI because that existing events.jsonl contains non-monotonic historical timestamps.
impact: The historical line cannot safely accept new events or be closed without rewriting append-only evidence. No hand edit was made; remaining acceptance work was isolated in this fresh formal line.
lesson: A formal event stream must be timestamp-valid before later waves depend on it; preserve an invalid historical stream and start a narrow successor line instead of rewriting evidence.

cause: The corrected acceptance runner discovered catalog and coverage inside the exact candidate, ran its fixed backend and frontend product-path suites, and verified that the candidate source state remained unchanged.
lesson: Bind every acceptance denominator and digest to the candidate interpreter, and preserve covered versus blocked rows instead of collapsing the matrix to a headline count.

cause: The candidate-acceptance hardening scope is implemented and its focused tests, candidate-bound deterministic run, provider non-fallback boundary, compileall and diff checks passed.
impact: This line closes only the acceptance infrastructure boundary. Browser, real provider, cross-process, full host/repository gate, merge, tag, release and deployment remain NOT_VERIFIED.
lesson: Close a narrow acceptance line with exact candidate identity and explicit downstream unknowns; do not promote a deterministic sidecar to product release evidence.
